queries.description: The invoice number or identifier. May appear next to 'Inv.no', 'INV. No.', 'Invoice No. & date', 'Invoice Number', or 'INV. No.'. Return only the number, not the date.
The date the invoice was issued. May appear next to 'Inv.no & date', 'Invoice No. & date', 'Date', or 'Dt.' Return as a date.

The full legal name of the selling or exporting company. Typically the company letterhead or header at the top of the page, or the value next to 'Exporter'. On a signed invoice, also appears in the 'For <CompanyName>' signature block.
The full address of the selling or exporting company (street, city/town, state/province, country). May appear in the company header or next to 'Exporter'.
The name of the buying or importing company. May appear next to 'Buyer', 'Consignee', 'Messrs', 'Bill To', or 'To'. If it says 'Same as Consignee', return the consignee name instead.
The full address of the buying or importing company. May appear next to 'Buyer', 'Consignee', or 'Messrs'.

The origin port or place from which goods were shipped. May appear next to 'Port of loading', 'Leaving', 'Port of departure', 'Shipped from', or in transport details as 'FROM <PLACE>'. Return the port or city name only.

The destination port where goods will arrive. May appear next to 'Port of discharge', 'Arriving', 'Final destination', 'Destination', or in transport details as 'TO <PLACE>'. Return the port or city name only.
The date goods were shipped or dispatched. May appear next to 'Shipdate', 'Ship date', 'Date of shipment', or 'Departure date'. Return as a date.

Payment terms such as 'Net 30', 'T/T in advance', '100% Advance', or 'Wire transfer'. May appear next to 'Payment terms' or 'Terms of payment'. Do NOT include Incoterms (EXW, FOB, CIF, EX-WORK) here — those belong to incoterms field.

International commercial trade terms (Incoterms) such as EXW, FOB, CIF, EX-WORK, CIP, DAP. May appear next to 'Terms of delivery', 'Trade terms', 'Terms of trade', 'Incoterms', or in the total line (e.g. 'TOTAL : EX-WORK'). Return the Incoterm code and delivery location if present (e.g. 'EXW TUMKUR', 'EX-WORK').
The invoice currency. Return only the 3-letter ISO code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Infer from currency symbols if needed: 'US$' or '$' = USD, '€' = EUR. Check currency symbols used on line item amounts.

The country where goods were manufactured or produced. May appear next to 'Country of origin of goods', 'Country of origin', or in a statement of origin such as 'products are of [Country] preferential origin' or 'entirely manufactured in [Country]'.
The final total invoice amount. May appear next to 'Total', 'TOTAL', 'Total::', 'Total:', 'TOTAL : EX-WORK', 'Invoice Total', or 'Amount Due'. Return as a currency value.

method.description: All line items listed in this commercial invoice. Each item represents one product, part, or goods description with its quantity and pricing.

properties.description: Description of the goods, part name, product name, or service. May include part numbers, revision codes, or specifications.

The Harmonized System (HS) tariff code for the goods. Typically a numeric code like '8708.99.9000' or '73269099'. May appear next to 'HS-Code', 'HS Code', 'Commodity Code', 'Tariff Code', or 'HTS'. If multiple HS codes appear for different line items, return the first one.

The buyer's purchase order or PO reference number. May appear next to 'PO no.', 'Purchase Order', 'Cust PO No.', 'Order No.', or 'S/C No.' (Sales Contract number). If multiple PO numbers appear, return the first one.
Quantity of units shipped for this line item. May appear in a column labeled 'Quantity', 'Qty', 'Pcs', 'In Nos', or 'Units'.
Price per single unit for this line item. May appear in a column labeled 'Unit Cost', 'Rate', 'Unit Price', 'Price/Unit', or 'USD/pc.'.
Total price for this line item (quantity × unit price). May appear in a column labeled 'Extended Cost', 'Amount', 'Ext. Price', 'Total', or 'Line Total'.
